name: Recursion Lab
desc: A recursion lab: Tower of Hanoi, Fibonacci call tree and factorial chain, with call counts, depth and optimal-move readouts.
controls: Disk-count and Fibonacci-n sliders, three presets (Hanoi/Fibonacci/Factorial), step/run/reset buttons; keys 1–3 switch demos, Space steps, G runs, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
